The /kiosk page itself stays mounted; works because TenantKioskLayout / Kiosk page handle their own login UI. PUBLIC_401_PATHS list uses startsWith — make sure no future endpoint shares a prefix (e.g., '/auth/login' would also match '/auth/login-with-otp'). Low risk but worth noting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 401-interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js now only hard-redirects to /login?stale=1 when path.startsWith('/admin'). Tenant/customer/kiosk-operator 401s clear their own token but stay on current route (their page-level UI handles re-login). PUBLIC_401_PATHS = [/auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/kiosk-pin, /tenant-portal/login, /tenant-portal/pin-login] are ignored entirely.
rca of the issue: Original iteration_19 interceptor unconditionally `window.location.assign('/login?stale=1')` on any 401 against a non-public endpoint. Tenant kiosk (/c/{slug}/kiosk/huurder) calls /tenant-portal/overview on mount; with no token (or wrong PIN) this returned 401 and the interceptor stole the navigation. Fix: scope the hard-redirect to admin paths only (path.startsWith('/admin')), and for tenant/kiosk just clear the relevant token + session storage and let the local page UI handle re-login. Verified across all 4 contexts.
